question: What is the comparison rate for someone borrowing 85% of the value?
reply: At 85% LVR (which falls in the LVR 80.01% to 90% band), the comparison rate is 6.47% p.a., per the Example Lender page (read 13 Oct 2026, 12:00 pm Perth time). This was current as of that reading — if you need it for anything time-sensitive, the page should be checked again for the current figure.
